description: Realize advertiser knowledge base — topic index. Encodes Realize advertiser best practices.
pathConvention: Every topic.path is relative to the directory containing this manifest file (i.e., the /knowledge directory).

topics.title: Bidding
topics.description: Bidding strategy selection, learning phase + learning-period guard, CPA troubleshooting, scaling adjustments, and the bid-levers matrix (what's valid at campaign / publisher / item level for each strategy).

topics.title: Tracking
topics.description: Tracking-method selection (pixel vs S2S), conversion-event strategy, ROAS tracking, parameters, and debugging. Does not cover platform install steps (web-fallback lookup) or live rule state (MCP).

topics.title: Targeting
topics.description: Audience strategy, geo / platform targeting, expansion playbook, retargeting, predictive audiences, and the 6-dimension narrow-targeting diagnostic.

topics.title: Creative
topics.description: Sponsored Content ads, display ads (overview), Gen AI AdMaker, landing pages, creative review process, creative testing, and creative fatigue. For Display item payload shape (3P `ad_tag` vs 1P `asset_url` + `dimensions`), see `targeting.md` → 'Native vs Display creative type'.

topics.title: Budget
topics.description: Budget planning, the 10× CPA rule, pacing, scaling, short-burst campaigns, depletion-miss investigation, and cross-period comparison rule (% share + Δ pp).

topics.title: Campaign Structure
topics.description: Campaign Groups, objectives, campaign types (Sponsored Content / Display) including the Native-vs-Display lock-in and the two MCP paths (CPC + first-item / VCPM), hierarchy, platform/device splits, and cross-period comparison of structural splits in % share.

topics.title: Brand Safety
topics.description: Native safety tools, DV / IAS integration, topic exclusions, and placement complaints.

topics.title: Custom Rules
topics.description: SpendGuard, Custom Rules, time-based rules, configuration best practices, and do's and don'ts.

topics.title: Site Management
topics.description: Publisher performance monitoring, blocking decisions with the historical-top-N block guard, approved-list dynamics, block-attribution families (rule / targeting / bid loss), and cross-cutting CPA / CVR diagnosis.

topics.title: Environments
topics.description: Environment overview and expansion strategy across Mail, Apple News, and Lockscreen inventory.

topics.title: Reach Estimation
topics.description: Campaign-level reach via `mcp__realize-mcp__get_campaign_reach_estimate` (never per-publisher). Inputs, outputs, IMPRESSIONS cap handling, narrow-targeting routing into the 6-dimension diagnostic in `targeting.md`.

topics.title: Reporting & Aggregation Discipline
topics.description: Pagination discipline + sum-reconciliation gate for every MCP-report-based answer. Codifies the rule that aggregating page 1 of a paginated report is a silent failure mode that understates spend on long-tail breakdowns. Mandatory read for any reporting / optimization question.
